name: Loli Shota HYBRID
source:
Young girl? Young boy? You can choose!! A hybrid adventure game!
The controls are simple.
Experience one setting but "two stories" :
A guy who loves imoutos x a young girl
OR
A senior at school club x a young boy

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ134250.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
年轻女孩？小男孩？你可以选择！！混合冒险游戏！
控制很简单。
体验一种环境但“两个故事”：
爱imoutos的男人x年轻的女孩
或
学校俱乐部的高年级学生x一个小男孩

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ134250.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
